# ActivityEvent

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened related to activity or exercise.

## Scope note

General activity-tracking events not covered by a more specific type - check for overlap with HealthEvent/MealEvent before applying.

## Broader

- [DiabetesEvent](../DiabetesEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
